The Traffic Commission and staff continue to develop the Neighborhood Traffic Management Program.
This month a Draft-2 is being presented. This Draft incorporates the Traffic Commission�s comments
from our last meeting. In addition, a criteria table has been developed to determine when toolbox
measures should be used.
Staff Recommendation
It is staff�s recommendation that the Traffic Commission review and discuss Draft-2 of the
Neighborhood Traffic Management Program.
B. STREET NAME SIGN DESIGN AND REPLACEMENT PROGRAM
SUMMARY
In accordance with Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) requirements, the City is
required to develop a replacement program for existing street name and regulatory signs. The sign replacement program is aimed at meeting minimum reflectivity and lettering standards for all City-owned signs as required by the FHWA and the State of California�s Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD). The existing street name sign background color of yellow is not compliant with the State MUTCD regulations. The replacement program includes developing an inventory of existing signs, determining costs to replace these signs, and a creating a replacement plan and schedule for installing new signs.
Staff Recommendation
Staff recommends that the Traffic Commission:
1. Review the street name sign options; and
2. Recommend to the City Council that new street name signs be replaced with white background and maroon lettering as funding allows and in conjunction with City public works projects.
